author: DEEPSEEK_AUX
kind: post hoc, zero-search re-analysis of the primary judge file only
motivation: Section 5 stratifies by cell, but 45 cells are not 45 positions: ten cells re-judge a position the other depth produced. Section 4 already reports distinct-position counts, so section 5 must not mix units. This analysis repeats the truncation stratification on distinct positions.
question: Does the truncation stratification of section 5 hold on distinct positions rather than correlated seed-depth cells?

input.note: primary hand-blind judge only; no other file is read

position_key: (seed, first_diff_ply, divergence_side, saved_moves_at_divergence.served, saved_moves_at_divergence.blind) - the same definition already used by summarize_judged_divergence.py
dedupe_rule: first occurrence ordered by depth (d2 kept), as in summarize_judged_divergence.py
endpoints_written_in_advance: D1: distinct position count and per-stratum counts, plus the number of positions whose duplicate occurrence has a different truncation stratum
D2: verdict distribution per stratum on distinct positions, and the same table excluding depth-6 tie-break cells
D3: seed-level majority tally per stratum on distinct positions
D4: group split (config_decided vs divergent_split) per stratum

decision_rule_written_in_advance.if_completed_stratum_distinct_positions_: the section-5 conclusion is recorded as holding on the distinct-position unit too; README and claim gain the distinct-position table as the primary form
the section-5 conclusion must be recorded as cell-level only and the completed stratum on distinct positions as not showing the same direction; both numbers are kept
decision_rule_written_in_advance.if_distinct_positions_in_completed_strat: record the distinct-position stratum as too small to decide and keep the cell-level statement as the only reported one

cost: zero searches, zero games; one file read
guards: refuse to overwrite an existing output file
assert the recomputed distinct-position count equals the 35 already recorded in README section 4
no p-values, no significance test, no new endpoint beyond D1-D4
done_condition: result JSON exists, the 35-position assertion passes, README section 5 carries the distinct-position numbers with the same post hoc label, and claim.json records this plan hash
consumer: the published truncation-stratified verdict in README section 5 and claim.json truncation_strata
